_comment: Ovid-equivalent model for the reproduction row (Tempelmeier & Demidova 2021): changeset + user features through dense layers, multi-head attention over per-edit features, no geometry (B1), no text (B2), no user sequence (B4) or edit order (B3). Same R1b split as Ovid's user-disjoint protocol. Differences, disclosed: Ovid zeroes edits above th_e,max, this keeps them (MapGuard rule 1); 'valid tags' is not reproduced.
